name: Worn Atmosphere Catalyst
desc: A sealed bed of Domain-era catalysts that breaks heavy and toxic gases down into lighter, cleaner ones. An atmosphere plant fitted with it treats more air with the same machines.

name: Pristine Atmosphere Catalyst
desc: A sealed bed of Domain-era catalysts that breaks heavy and toxic gases down into lighter, cleaner ones. An atmosphere plant fitted with it treats more air with the same machines.

name: Worn Gas Synthesis Core
desc: A compact Domain-era gas processor that can build up an atmosphere from volatiles, or take one apart. Fitted to an atmosphere plant, it moves gas faster than the plant's own machines can.

name: Pristine Gas Synthesis Core
desc: A compact Domain-era gas processor that can build up an atmosphere from volatiles, or take one apart. Fitted to an atmosphere plant, it moves gas faster than the plant's own machines can.

name: Worn Metamaterial Weave
desc: Rolls of a Domain metamaterial whose surface can be tuned to reflect or pass any band of light. Orbital shades and mirrors built with it go up much faster.

name: Pristine Metamaterial Weave
desc: Rolls of a Domain metamaterial whose surface can be tuned to reflect or pass any band of light. Orbital shades and mirrors built with it go up much faster.

name: Worn Photon Lens
desc: A Domain-era focusing lens, grown in zero gravity, that gathers weak starlight into a usable beam. A solar concentrator fitted with one loses little of the light it catches.

name: Pristine Photon Lens
desc: A Domain-era focusing lens, grown in zero gravity, that gathers weak starlight into a usable beam. A solar concentrator fitted with one loses little of the light it catches.

name: Worn Fusion Ignition Core
desc: The ignition and containment core of a Domain fusion lamp, salvaged whole. It brings an artificial sun to full output much sooner.

name: Pristine Fusion Ignition Core
desc: The ignition and containment core of a Domain fusion lamp, salvaged whole. It brings an artificial sun to full output much sooner.

name: Worn Seismic Damper Core
desc: A Domain-era control core that reads the stresses in a planet's crust and fires counter-pulses before a quake can build. Crustal works steered by it settle a world's crust much sooner.

name: Pristine Seismic Damper Core
desc: A Domain-era control core that reads the stresses in a planet's crust and fires counter-pulses before a quake can build. Crustal works steered by it settle a world's crust much sooner.

name: Worn Weather Lattice Core
desc: A Domain weather-control processor that models a whole planet's air as it moves. It lets a dampener grid break up storms while they are still forming.

name: Pristine Weather Lattice Core
desc: A Domain weather-control processor that models a whole planet's air as it moves. It lets a dampener grid break up storms while they are still forming.

name: Worn Climate Matrix
desc: A Domain-era climate model, held in a crystal processor, that balances heat, wind and rain across a whole world at once.

name: Pristine Climate Matrix
desc: A Domain-era climate model, held in a crystal processor, that balances heat, wind and rain across a whole world at once.

name: Worn Ion Shield Core
desc: A superconducting field core from a Domain planetary shield. Linked to a magnetosphere generator, it raises a strong field quickly.

name: Pristine Ion Shield Core

name: Worn Gravitic Tether
desc: A Domain gravitic projector that grips a mass from far away and steers it along a precise path. Crews with one bring comets in, or lift ice off a planet, much faster.

name: Pristine Gravitic Tether
desc: A Domain gravitic projector that grips a mass from far away and steers it along a precise path. Crews with one bring comets in, or lift ice off a planet, much faster.

name: Worn Biosphere Seed Vault
desc: A cold vault of Domain gene stock: soil microbes, plankton, seeds and their tailored symbionts. Seeding and cleanup crews with it start from proven strains instead of breeding their own.

name: Pristine Biosphere Seed Vault

desc: A Domain-era nanite catalyst that loosens rock along mineral seams. Extraction works fitted with it cut through a deposit much faster.
